ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
As shown in the figure, in a uniform electric field, a small ball of mass m and charge quantity +q is released from rest and moves in a straight line obliquely downward. The trajectory makes an angle θ with the vertical direction. Then
A. The minimum value of the field strength is $\frac{mg}{q}$
B. The direction of the electric field may be horizontally to the left
C. The electric field force may do no work on the small ball
D. The electric potential energy of the small ball may increase

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the small ball is released from an upper position, and next to it a vertically downward reference line is drawn; the small ball's motion trajectory is an obliquely downward straight line, and the angle θ between this trajectory and the vertical direction is marked. Reasoning: The stem states that the small ball carries positive charge +q, is released from rest in a uniform electric field, and moves in a straight line in the obliquely downward direction shown in the figure. Since the small ball starts from rest and moves in a straight line under the action of constant forces, the direction of the resultant force must be consistent with the trajectory direction. Decompose gravity mg along the trajectory direction; its component along the trajectory direction is mg cosθ. Let the magnitude of the resultant force along the trajectory direction be F; then the component of the electric field force along the trajectory direction is F - mg cosθ. The problem does not limit the magnitude of the electric field strength, so it is possible that F < mg cosθ. At this time, the component of the electric field force along the trajectory direction is opposite to the displacement direction, and the electric field force does negative work on the small ball. From the electric potential energy change relation ΔEp = -W_electric, it can be known that when the electric field force does negative work, the small ball's electric potential energy increases. Therefore the electric potential energy of the small ball may increase during the motion.

method.method_draft: 从图中确认小球的实际位移方向是斜向下，且与竖直方向夹角为θ；从题干读取小球带正电、由静止释放、在匀强电场中沿直线运动。由“由静止在恒力作用下做直线运动”可知合力方向必须与轨迹方向一致。把重力mg竖直向下分解到轨迹方向上，其沿轨迹方向分量为mg cosθ。设合力沿轨迹方向大小为F，则电场力沿轨迹方向的分量为F - mg cosθ。由于题中没有限定电场强度大小，F可以小于mg cosθ，此时电场力沿轨迹方向分量与位移方向相反，电场力做负功。根据电势能变化量ΔEp = -W电，电场力做负功时电势能增加，因此小球电势能在运动过程中可能增加。
